description: Matelot waterfall is a beautiful natural waterfall located in the quiet village of Matelot on Trinidad's nort coast. Surrounded by lush rainsforest, it flows into cool, clear pools that are perfect for relaxing and enjoying nature. Check current opening arrangements, visitor access and any fees before travelling.
